stress_cases.reason: Fixedness depends on the image permutation group, so quotienting the action kernel preserves the fixed locus.
A partial operation is not an arrow of the declared Set-valued groupoid action without a separately supplied partial-action category and naturality law.

A multiple fixed locus does not imply global multiplicity when a complementary factor is empty; factorwise nonemptiness for an arbitrary infinite family still needs a product element or suitable choice principle.
A transitive three-point orbit has no invariant point but has an invariant uniform probability measure; the deterministic theorem is not a stochastic no-go theorem.
A selector-relevant mark changes the source object, automorphism group, or eligibility set; a mark that records the answer relocates rather than derives the selection burden.

stress_cases.fixed_locus_monotonicity: D^G subseteq D^H for H subseteq G
stress_cases.reason: Narrowing the admitted variation group can create fixed points and widening it can remove them; choosing the variation class is separate source-law data.

ontology_law_failure_branches.collapse: Stochastic orbit averaging collapses point distinctions into one invariant distribution without producing an invariant point.
ontology_law_failure_branches.nonuniqueness: The identity-only variation subgroup leaves both choices fixed.
ontology_law_failure_branches.inverse_defect: The partial-map fixture lacks a total inverse and is not an arrow of the certified groupoid.
ontology_law_failure_branches.cocycle_defect: No partial-action composition or naturality cocycle is supplied for the partial-map fixture.
ontology_law_failure_branches.finite_variation_fragility: Changing the admitted variation group from the swap group to its identity subgroup changes the fixed locus from empty to two points.
